items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: That's what he told me. He said, he always hit it hard.

ctx.x: Yeah. Now, those trumpet players, let's start comparing some more of them to get that style down, if that helped you. Let's see. You see, nobody played much like Keppert, huh?

Well, Keppert was a rough fellow. He could hit them hard notes rough and quick, you know, like that. He played nice horn, but I mean, when he hit something, he just hit it hard and heavy. That's what he told me. He said, he always hit it hard. Don't blow it easy, hit it hard.
And, you know, he was a nice. Now, did Bunk play anything like him?
